rows.post_name: Assistant Communication Officer (ACO) - Brand Content & Marketing

content_sections.heading: Post-Wise Details
content_sections.text: Job Profile: Develop and maintain brand positioning, communication framework and brand guidelines. Create content strategy, articles, blogs, reports, case studies and executive communication content. Manage social media platforms and audience engagement strategies. Develop marketing collateral, videos, presentations and digital assets. Execute paid marketing campaigns across Google, LinkedIn, Meta, YouTube, X and other platforms. Analyse campaign performance and optimise marketing initiatives. Job Profile: Manage website strategy, governance and optimisation. Develop SEO and GEO strategies. Conduct technical SEO audits and monitor website performance. Manage CMS, CRM, analytics, marketing automation and campaign platforms. Develop dashboards, tracking frameworks and analytics reports. Support AI, automation and digital transformation initiatives. Job Profile: Conduct Risk Based Internal Audit (RBIA), management audits and special audits. Prepare audit reports and compliance observations. Follow up with offices for closure of audit observations. Assist in data analytics and audit process improvement. Provide inputs for improving credit and operational processes.

tables.caption: 1. Assistant Communication Officer (ACO) - Brand Content & Marketing

content_sections.heading: Educational Qualification
content_sections.text: MBA/PGDM in Marketing, Communications, Digital Marketing or equivalent qualification. Graduate degree in Engineering/Computer Science/MBA (Marketing Analytics, Digital Marketing) or equivalent from a recognised University/Institute. Qualified Chartered Accountant from ICAI with required experience. OR Qualified Cost and Management Accountant (CMA) from ICMAI with required experience. OR M.Com with minimum 55% marks with required audit experience.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: The candidate should not be more than 35 years of age as on 31 August 2026 .

content_sections.heading: Experience Required
content_sections.text: Minimum 5 years of post-qualification experience in brand management, content marketing, social media, campaign management and paid media. B2B and institutional marketing experience is preferred. Minimum 5 years of post-qualification experience in website management, SEO, analytics, digital experience and Martech. Experience with CMS, CRM, GA4, Search Console, marketing automation, SEO platforms and BI tools is preferred. CA/CMA candidates: Minimum 2 years experience in audit function or operational areas. M.Com candidates: Minimum 3 years audit experience.
